title: Generate object word list via LLM batch script
story: As a developer, I want a curated list of concrete, sensory-rich object words bundled with the app so that users always get a suitable writing prompt.
acceptance_criteria: A one-off Node or Python script exists that calls the Anthropic API to generate a list of object words
Output is saved as src/data/words.json — an array of strings
Words are concrete nouns suitable for object writing (e.g. 'campfire', 'leather glove', 'rain gutter')
The script and instructions for re-running it are documented in the project README
